title: World Bank multidimensional poverty headcount, October 2025 brief
sourceIndicatorId: Poverty & Equity Brief October 2025: Multidimensional Poverty Measure

metadata.provenance: World Bank Poverty & Equity Brief, India, October 2025.
metadata.method: Brief-specific World Bank Multidimensional Poverty Measure estimate for India. The same brief notes data are derived from a 2022 survey/2022-23 HCES context.
metadata.caveat: This differs from the WDI API SI.POV.MPWB value of 17.7% for 2022. The article keeps both as official World Bank context and does not mix either with consumption-poverty headcounts.
